misses.counterfactual_theory: A frozen record linking each forecast’s specification, issuance time, evidence cutoff, and matured outcome could enable an ex-ante comparison. The supplied evidence does not establish that this would have changed a decision or reduced a demonstrated loss.
misses.decision_reference: The supplied settlement records identify forecasts but omit forecast contents, issuance times, and eligible evidence cutoffs. The registry explicitly describes this as an auditability gap, not a demonstrated decision failure.
misses.decision_relevance: Without the forecast specification and timing provenance, the later settlement prices cannot be compared with what was forecast before those outcomes.
misses.miss_description: DATA_GAP_ONLY: confirmed target-time mark prices are provided for forecast IDs, but no corresponding ex-ante forecasts or issuance/cutoff records are supplied. No decision miss can be established from these settlements.
misses.missing_history_problem: The settlement records contain point-in-time outcomes but not immutable forecast specifications, issuance times, or eligible evidence cutoffs; therefore, whether any forecast was missed cannot be determined.
misses.outcome_reference: Settlement evidence records include confirmed target-time prices, for example EXP-FC-f9b7fcc9fbc3e09be1f5 (BTC-USDT-SWAP, 79,635.7) and EXP-FC-fe4f390da43656d3bc36 (BTC-USDT-SWAP, 78,393.3). These are point outcomes, not portfolio results.
misses.proposed_metric_name: Frozen forecast specification, issuance/evidence-cutoff, and linked matured-outcome record
